description: This file is the main implementation of the 'git' command-line interface, handling command parsing, execution, and internal command dispatching.

methods.name: list_builtins
methods.description: Populates a list with available built-in commands, optionally filtering by include or exclude options.

methods.name: get_builtin
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the command struct for a given command name if it exists.

methods.name: is_builtin
methods.description: Checks if a command name corresponds to a built-in command.

methods.name: load_builtin_commands
methods.description: Loads commands with a specific prefix into a command list.

methods.name: handle_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and sets environment variables or internal flags accordingly.

methods.name: handle_alias
methods.description: Expands command aliases, detects loops, and modifies argument vectors.

methods.name: run_builtin
methods.description: Executes a built-in command, handling setup and cleanup.

methods.name: execv_dashed_external
methods.description: Executes external commands prefixed with 'git-' via a child process.

methods.name: is_deprecated_command
methods.description: Checks if a command is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: run_argv
methods.description: Main loop for processing command arguments, handling aliases, and executing commands.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git' command-line interface, handling initial argument parsing and command dispatch.
